index: Saipan Consumer Price Index, all items, 2nd Quarter 2017 = 100, Central Statistics Division, CNMI Department of Commerce
note: Quarterly: each year's mean is of its four quarters (100.35 and 101.35). The Central Statistics Division publishes an index for each island (Saipan, Tinian, Rota) and none for the Commonwealth, so Saipan's, the island most of its people live on, stands for it (the lead's ruling of 2026-11-02), as a capital's index stands for a country elsewhere. Carried to 2024, not 2025: the Division's revised Q4 2025 report gives 2025 levels (112.5, 112.5, 112.9, 112.6) that its own rates contradict (2025.01's 0.9% on 2024.04's 100.9 is about 101.8), so they are left out.

CNMI Department of Commerce, Central Statistics Division, Saipan CPI, 4th quarter 2025, revised (the PDF made 2026-10-09)
sources.note: Its 2021 to 2024 quarters are the Q4 2024 report's. Its 2025 levels contradict its own rates: 0.9% on 2024.04's 100.9 is about 101.8, not 112.5, and 2025.04's annual 0.9% gives about 101.8, not 112.6; so its 2025 levels aren't used, and the level is carried to 2024.
